Lina (People Ops): Quick note 11 Devon (Platform Eng, L3) starts Monday 9am PT. Dropping a small manager playbook + who-to-ask so Ravi has a single checklist.
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Thanks Lina. Plan: 20m intro + 40m infra tour. Can we get laptop, slack invite, and sandbox tokens before start?
Becky (IT): Device order submitted. Ravi: MacBook Pro 14 or Linux workstation? Also list Slack channels to auto-join.
Ravi (Hiring Manager): MacBook Pro 14, add to #platform, #deploy, #oncall-shadows. Cloud groups: aws-staging-read, ci-trigger.
Lina (People Ops): Manager playbook (copy this):
- Before Day 1: Okta + device order, Slack + calendar invites, payroll forms complete, upload signed offer to #people-ops-private.
- Day 1 AM: 9am manager intro (20m), badge & SSO, buddy meet, quick security smoke test.
- Day 1 PM: 1pm"first-week map" with links, 3pm infra shadow schedule.
- Day 2-3: dev env, repo access, assign small infra task (rotate sandbox secret + open a PR).
- Week 1: daily 1:1s short, runbook tour, assign mentor sessions.
- Feedback cadence: day3 quick sync, week2 check, week4 review, then monthly.
- 30/60/90 template: 30 learn systems & ship small change; 60 own a component; 90 lead a measurable improvement and present to team.
Noah (Buddy): I'll be Devon's buddy. I'll send a 1pm coffee invite Day1 and "who-to-ask" doc.
Sam (Security): We'll run a 10m secrets hygiene at Mon 4pm and send a 2-page pre-read (secrets-quickstart.md). No prod creds in onboarding tasks.
Becky (IT): Provisioning sandbox service account with 1 hour TTL tokens. I'll DM the ephemeral token steps and laptop imaging ETA (Fri EOD).
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Mini task: rotate a demo secret in sandbox, run CI, open PR for review. Teaches creds handling + pipeline.
Lina (People Ops): Added timezone visibility note to the playbook (confirm calendar timezone and working hours).
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Also please add a line to confirm any contract addenda (non-competes) before Day1.
Lina (People Ops): Done. OnboardBot: checklist created https://onboard.example/2234567890 :party:
Noah (Buddy): I'll attach the team 1-pager and a short list of "who-to-ask" (IT, Security, Oncall, Docs).
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Great work, team. Anything else missing?
Becky (IT): I'll ping when laptop is ready for pickup and confirm Slack invites.
Sam (Security): Sending pre-read now. Will host the live 10m runthrough Mon 4pm.
Lina (People Ops): Thanks all 70; see you Monday to welcome Devon!
